title: Closed exhibits and Updates/Events
preconditions: Specific Map. Seed may include updates/events; closed exhibits may be Blocked → CON-04 / CON-13 / CON-14.
dateUnderTest: Record Specific Map date; also change date mid-suite.

steps.name: Updates tab
steps.do: In Explore, open **Updates** (under Updates and events).
steps.expect: Tab selected; list or empty state shown.

steps.name: Updates content sanity
steps.do: Read empty state or update cards.

steps.name: Collapse/expand
steps.do: Use show/hide updates control (**Hide updates and events** / **Show updates and events**).

steps.name: Updates carousel
steps.do: If multiple updates, use previous/next update controls.
steps.expect: Carousel advances **or** N/A if only one/none.

steps.name: Events tab
steps.expect: Events list or empty state shown.

steps.name: Change map date
steps.do: On Specific Map, change the date.

steps.name: Updates/Events refresh
steps.do: Recheck Updates and Events after date change.
steps.expect: Content refreshes for the new date.

steps.name: Closed exhibit overlay
steps.do: If a closed exhibit exists for the date, find overlay.

steps.name: Open date without overlay
steps.do: Pick a date without closure (or after noting Blocked).
